tui.description: Gradual rollout of the new React/Ink TUI to replace legacy terminal UI

kas.description: Default the new-TUI engine to KAS (V3) instead of V2 when no engine is explicitly selected; ramp via treatment_percent

remote_sandbox.description: Remote/cloud sandbox sessions (hidden --remote/--repo flags). Dark-shipped at 0% so it is OFF in every released build; only debug/KIRO_TEST_MODE/E2E enable it. Ramp via treatment_percent (internal nightly first) once E2E-ready.

voice.description: Voice input mode - all internal users

infra_safety.description: ICECAP infrastructure-safety gate (monitor/enforce). Internal-only initially; launcher exports KIRO_INFRA_SAFETY_ROLLOUT_ENABLED and the TUI advertises the capability + honors the infraSafety settings only when enabled. Ramp via treatment_percent.

lite.description: Lite TUI mode - stable channel, Amazon employees only

test_internal_only.description: Test experiment for unit tests (internal only)

test_nightly_only.description: Test experiment for unit tests (nightly channel only)

v2_non_interactive.description: Default non-interactive and piped-stdin to V2 engine instead of V1

memory.description: Persistent agent memory. Dark-shipped at 0% while under development; ramp via treatment_percent.

workflows.description: KAS dynamic workflows and TUI workflow management. Dark-shipped at 0% until release certification is complete; enable locally through KIRO_ENABLED_FEATURES.

c2s.description: Code-to-Spec Explore agent and analysis pipeline. Internal nightly only; launcher exports KIRO_C2S_ROLLOUT_ENABLED and the TUI honors chat.enableC2s + shows the Explore agent only when enabled.
